description.value: Dogwood Brewing is an independent craft brewery established in 2015 in South Vancouver, specializing in organically-crafted beer sold primarily in cans. Their 50-seat tasting room sits two blocks west of the Knight Street Bridge and pours house beers alongside ciders, wine, pizza, and snacks. The space doubles as a private event venue and offers growler fills and canned beer to take away.
